Use case: production Unity pixel-art sprite animation (stylized-concept).
Input image role: existing approved hero animation reference; use the FIRST pose as the exact character identity and idle pose. Create a NEW ultimate-casting animation of this same hero.
Deliver EXACTLY EIGHT sequential full-body frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, left to right, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Intended normalized delivery is 2048 x 256, 8 equal 256 x 256 cells. If the generator needs a taller image, keep all eight poses on a single common baseline with generous empty transparent space above and below. Never wrap into rows.
Character invariants: youthful male Chinese wuxia swordsman, long black high ponytail tied gold, dark navy/black gold-trim martial coat and boots, white V collar, warm tan skin, brown/gold belt and wrist guards, the same slim straight steel jian sword. Same readable pixel clusters and large-head body proportions as reference, same body size in every frame, three-quarter RIGHT facing throughout. No character redesign.
Every frame must contain the HERO performing a genuinely different articulated pose AND its own baked-in magical effects following his hand, blade, arms, clothing and feet. Effects must change with the motion, not be a separate aura overlay pasted onto the same idle pose. Powerful but keep face and dark costume identifiable.
Keep each body near center of its cell, common planted foot baseline, consistent standing body height. Leave generous transparent margins around each silhouette and all effects; no pixels crossing into neighbouring cells, no clipping. No floor shadow, scenery, UI, labels, text, frame borders, or watermark.
Frame 0: recognizable reference idle pose with sword low, no effect. Frame 7: return to that same idle pose, no effect. Frames 1-6 are the distinct action described below.
